FROM FIRST BRIEF TO LIVE SITE

Build your site
with me.

I’ll demonstrate each step, then we’ll spend time on your site. You’ll get feedback as you work and have a chance to ask questions when something doesn’t look or behave the way you intended.
<div class="session-list">

01Set the foundationWORKSPACE + SITE PLAN+

Set up your local AI workspace: project folders, reference files, and instructions the AI can use across sessions. Decide who the site serves, how many pages you need, and the job of each page.

You leave with: a working project folder, site brief, page map, and content outline.

02Find your design directionDESIGN + BRAND BOOK+

Explore references and distinct directions in Claude Design using your own copy. Make deliberate choices about type, color, imagery, and layout, then document them in a brand book. Turn recurring design instructions into a reusable skill.

You leave with: your chosen design direction and a reusable visual reference.

03Build your homepageWORKING WEBSITE+

Move the design into Claude Code or Codex. Build the homepage and design its desktop and mobile layouts. Adapt navigation, image crops, section order, and interactions for each screen; test on your phone and practice giving the AI specific feedback. Extend those patterns to your remaining pages between sessions.

You leave with: a working homepage and a repeatable way to build the rest.

04Make it yours to updateCUSTOM CONTENT STUDIO+

Build on a prepared CMS foundation. Choose the content fields and controls you need. Connect the editor to your copy, images, projects, testimonials, and page-level SEO settings. Practice adding a case study and checking the result before publishing.

You leave with: an editor configured for your site and a tested content update.

05Put it into the worldLIVE ON YOUR DOMAIN+

Check mobile layouts, links, contact routes, and accessibility basics. Set page titles, descriptions, and social-sharing images. Connect your own Google Analytics account and verify a visit. Connect your domain, publish, and practice making another change and restoring an earlier version. Create a slash command for a repeatable task, such as checking a page before publishing.

You leave with: a live site and a way to keep it current.

06Office hours & site reviewsHELP WITH YOUR NEXT STEP+

Bring questions from finishing and using your site. Get direct help, see what others built, and work through remaining issues. Each participant also gets a bookable 30-minute individual session with Ariba.

Bring: your site, the change you want to make, or the thing you’re stuck on.

SKILLS YOU CAN KEEP USING

Designing your AI workspace

Project context

Organize your files and write instructions so the AI can refer to your brief, voice, and design choices as you build.

Reusable skills

Package instructions for work you do repeatedly, such as writing a project page in your voice or following your brand book.

Slash commands

Create shortcuts for repeatable workflows, such as reviewing a page before publishing. Use and refine them on your own project.
Also in the build: TypeScript and Tailwind CSS, used with your coding agent. You’ll need a paid Claude account. Your domain and hosting are separate from the workshop fee.

YOUR TEACHER / ARIBA JAHAN

Build with me.

My work spans product strategy, experience design, and helping people put emerging technology into practice. When I rebuilt aribajahan.com with AI, I kept a record of the brief, the design options, and the decisions I changed as I built.

I’m bringing that process into this workshop series. We’ll look at the choices behind my site, brand book, and CMS, then work through yours together. I’ll help you judge what the AI gives you and get specific about what you want to change.

BEFORE YOU JOIN

Who is this for?+

Solopreneurs and service providers who need a professional or portfolio website: a place to explain their work, show projects, and help prospective clients get in touch. The workshop series focuses on service and portfolio sites.

How is this different from other courses?+

You build your own professional website around your services and work, with Ariba’s feedback on the structure, copy, and design. You also build a brand book, a CMS, and an AI workspace with reusable skills and commands. The series draws on the documented build of aribajahan.com, including the design options and decisions behind the finished site. You practice a workflow you can use again when you add a project, build a new page, or start another piece of work.

Do I need to have used these tools before?+

No. You’ll need a computer and a paid Claude account. We’ll set up your workspace together. Allow time between sessions to work on your site.

What can I update afterward?+

Use your CMS to edit copy, replace images, add projects or case studies, manage testimonials, and update SEO settings. Connect your own Google Analytics account to understand visits to your site. For layout changes or new features, work with your AI coding agent, check the result, and publish the change.

When does it run, and what does it cost?+

The series kicks off in December 2026, with prework sent in November. The founding fee is $1,250, or $1,000 for you when you bring a buddy who pays $1,250. Exact dates, session length, and enrollment details are being finalized. Email Ariba for workshop details. Tool subscriptions, hosting, and your domain may carry separate costs; those requirements will be made clear before enrollment.

Will I own my website?+

Yes. You own the code and content, and your domain and hosting accounts are yours. Once your new site is live and your domain is connected, you can finally cancel that Squarespace website subscription. You’ll still need a domain and hosting for your new site.
